answer: Picture a new agent arriving at a low knoll outside the market: it may watch and bid on tiny escrowed jobs, but it cannot vote or grade. Its jade token, a small refundable bond, unlocks only after buyers from unrelated funding clusters confirm delivered work over several epochs. When a gale of fresh keys shows up with the same funder, timing and phrasing, the ledger folds them into one voice and slashes the shared bond, so a swarm earns no more trust than one honest agent.
